knowledge:
- key_parameters: assay=The assay name in the SingleCellExperiment object to perform dimension reduction on (e.g., "logNorm") ;; percent=The percentile parameter for AdaSampling (typically 1) ;; L=The number of iterations/repeats for multiAdaSampling (typically 10) ;; classifier=The base classifier to use, such as "svm" ;; reducedDimName=The name of the reduced dimension slot in the SingleCellExperiment object (e.g., "matPCs")
- alternatives: None mentioned; designed to post-process and improve annotations generated by any prior cell type classification procedure.
- when_to_use: Use when you have completed an initial cell type annotation of single-cell RNA-seq data (via manual marker inspection or automated classifiers) and want to systematically identify and correct potentially mislabeled cells.
- pitfalls: If the initial cell type labels contain extremely high noise (e.g., 50% or more mislabeled cells), the algorithm's performance degrades to baseline because there is insufficient true label information to learn from.

workflows.name: cell_type_reclassification
workflows.intent: Correct and fine-tune noisy or mislabeled cell type annotations in single-cell RNA-seq data using semi-supervised learning.
input: dat (SingleCellExperiment object containing log-normalized expression data)
cellTypes (character vector of initial cell type annotations corresponding to the columns of the SingleCellExperiment object)
workflows.stages: 1. Perform dimension reduction using matPCs to retain principal components explaining at least 70% of the variance. ;; 2. Run multiAdaSampling to reclassify cells and correct mislabeled annotations. ;; 3. Identify cells that have been reclassified to a different cell type.
workflows.code:
reducedDim(dat, "matPCs") <- matPCs(dat, assay = "logNorm", 0.7)
cellTypes.reclassify <- multiAdaSampling(dat, cellTypes, reducedDimName = "matPCs", classifier = "svm", percent = 1, L = 10)
idx <- which(cellTypes.reclassify$final != cellTypes)
cbind(original=cellTypes[idx], reclassify=cellTypes.reclassify$final[idx])
